entry_state: Chapter 12 closes with distinct issued and held transition balances, scoped timing exceptions and dated reported evidence. Insurance quantities require their own group, method, information and source history; numerical illustrations and documentary exchanges leave actual calibration and implementation acceptance pending. The next chapter turns to implementation contracts.
exit_state: The implementation specifies one transactional owner, immutable evidence and views, complete request fingerprints and independent result statuses. Corrections follow candidate-set dependencies without rewriting old selections. Durability, checkpoints and migrations have observable requirements, while the plugin interface must expose all material numerical inputs and preserve unknown solver outcomes.
findings: Storage separates candidate calculations from committed accounting, including receipt and branch-head publication.
Incomplete computation does not authorize conditioning on successful results; the interval example retains unavailable mass.
Correction, selection and invalidation have separate records and effects. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
